audit_metadata.project_title: Explainable Graph-Based Temporal Modeling of Social Behaviours for Autism Assessment
audit_metadata.clinical_disclaimer: FOR CLINICAL DECISION-SUPPORT RESEARCH PURPOSES ONLY. Not for autonomous or definitive clinical diagnosis.
audit_metadata.leakage_prevention_protocol: Protocols vary by artifact. MMASD uses subject_id grouping; advanced AV-ASD segment results use video_id grouping. Verify participant-level independence before claiming zero subject overlap. ASBD/SSBD has no reproducible local evaluation artifact.

AV_ASD_update_2026_11_12.scope: Added nested video-context and video-level experiments using the local audio-only audit bundle.
AV_ASD_update_2026_11_12.important_caveat: The earlier 961-segment 76.59% accuracy is dominated by one video containing 506 segments, all from one class; the other four folds together score about 58.9%. Do not interpret pooled segment accuracy as stable video/participant generalization.
AV_ASD_update_2026_11_12.multimodal_inputs: No local AV-ASD raw video, pose/keypoint, or speech embedding features were found; target-speaker and participant identities remain unverified.

AV_ASD_4_Classes.metric: Accuracy = 50.55% (XGBoost Audio Benchmark), surpassing 50% threshold on 4 naturalistic classes

AV_ASD_3_Class_Stimming.metric: Accuracy = 55.90%, Macro-F1 = 0.5576, surpassing both 50% Accuracy and 50% F1 barriers

ASBD_SSBD_Stimming_Domain.metric: Not verifiable: no local source data or standalone evaluation artifact. The prior 55.90% / 0.5576 values duplicate AV-ASD 3-class values and must not be attributed to ASBD/SSBD without evidence.

AV_ASD_4_Class_Audio_XGB.evaluation_protocol: Reported as subject_id GroupKFold for clip benchmark; advanced segment artifacts use video_id. Verify participant-level independence.
classes: Hyper- or Hyporeactivity to Sensory Input

AV_ASD_3_Class_Stimming.evaluation_protocol: Reported as subject_id GroupKFold for clip benchmark; advanced segment artifacts use video_id. Verify participant-level independence.
classes: Hyper- or Hyporeactivity to Sensory Input

new_video_context_segment_experiment.evaluation: Nested 5-fold GroupKFold by video_id; inner 3-fold model selection
new_video_context_segment_experiment.interpretation: Below majority baseline on pooled segment accuracy; fold-level performance highly variable; experimental audio-context method.

new_video_level_experiment.evaluation: Nested 5-fold stratified evaluation on one sample per video; 3-fold inner model selection
new_video_level_experiment.interpretation: Above majority-video baseline but below 80%; this is a video-level majority-label task, not segment recognition; participant IDs unverified.

segment_level_distribution_audit.note: 506 distinct segment IDs span approximately 29 minutes; not duplicate rows.

ASBD_SSBD_Stimming.dataset_name: Autism Stimming Behaviour Dataset (ASBD / SSBD) Motor Transfer Benchmark
ASBD_SSBD_Stimming.evaluation_protocol: Unverified: no local source data, subject identifiers, or standalone result artifact

results.evidence_note: These values duplicate the AV-ASD 3-class result; no standalone ASBD/SSBD source data or evaluation artifact was located. Do not treat as a validated ASBD/SSBD result.
